entries.title: Job 28:1
segments: ¶Truly there is a mine for silver, and a place where gold is washed out.

entries.title: Job 28:2
segments: Iron is taken out of the earth, and stone is changed into brass by the fire.

entries.title: Job 28:3
segments: Man puts an end to the dark, searching out to the farthest limit the stones of the deep places of the dark.

entries.title: Job 28:4
segments: He makes a deep mine far away from those living in the light of day; when they go about on the earth, they have no knowledge of those who are under them, who are hanging far from men, twisting from side to side on a cord.

entries.title: Job 28:5
segments: As for the earth, bread comes out of it; but under its face it is turned up as if by fire.

entries.title: Job 28:6
segments: Its stones are the place of sapphires, and it has dust of gold.

entries.title: Job 28:7
segments: No bird has knowledge of it, and the hawk's eye has never seen it.

entries.title: Job 28:8
segments: The great beasts have not gone over it, and the cruel lion has not taken that way.

entries.title: Job 28:9
segments: Man puts out his hand on the hard rock, overturning mountains by the roots.

entries.title: Job 28:10
segments: He makes deep ways, cut through the rock, and his eye sees everything of value.

entries.title: Job 28:11
segments: He keeps back the streams from flowing, and makes the secret things come out into the light.

entries.title: Job 28:12
segments: But where may wisdom be seen? and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

entries.title: Job 28:13
segments: Man has not seen the way to it, and it is not in the land of the living.

entries.title: Job 28:14
segments: ¶The deep waters say, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.

entries.title: Job 28:15
segments: Gold may not be given for it, or a weight of silver in payment for it.

entries.title: Job 28:16
segments: It may not be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the onyx of great price, or the sapphire.

entries.title: Job 28:17
segments: Gold and glass are not equal to it in price, and it may not be exchanged for jewels of the best gold.

entries.title: Job 28:18
segments: There is no need to say anything about coral or crystal; and the value of wisdom is greater than that of pearls.

entries.title: Job 28:19
segments: The topaz of Ethiopia is not equal to it, and it may not be valued with the best gold.

entries.title: Job 28:20
segments: ¶From where then does wisdom come, and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

entries.title: Job 28:21
segments: For it is kept secret from the eyes of all living, unseen by the birds of the air.

entries.title: Job 28:22
segments: Destruction and Death say, We have only had word of it with our ears.

entries.title: Job 28:23
segments: God has knowledge of the way to it, and of its resting-place;

entries.title: Job 28:24
segments: For his eyes go to the ends of the earth, and he sees everything under heaven.

entries.title: Job 28:25
segments: When he made a weight for the wind, measuring out the waters;

entries.title: Job 28:26
segments: When he made a law for the rain, and a way for the thunder-flames;

entries.title: Job 28:27
segments: Then he saw it, and put it on record; he gave it its fixed form, searching it out completely.

entries.title: Job 28:28
segments: And he said to man, Truly the fear of the Lord is wisdom, and to keep from evil is the way to knowledge.
